symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: When the level or the session is unloading it runs only ProcessLevelUnloading ('LevelUnload processing' / 'SessionUnload processing'). Otherwise it runs ProcessCampTriggerEvents, CollectPostponedCharacterInTriggerUpdates and ProcessPresenceRequests; then, only when a global camp-settings entity is found and alive, ProcessGatherAtCampCheckRequests, ProcessEnableSendToCampRequests, ProcessEnableCampWaypointRequests and ProcessSetEndTheDayStateRequests on it.

does.text: Camp trigger enter/leave events of characters are turned into per-character updates (a character that is dead or whose UUID is not registered is reported). ProcessCharacterInTriggerUpdates compares the old and the new camp trigger of a character: new trigger empty means 'Entity leaves camp', old empty means 'Entity enters camp', both set and different means 'Entity swaps camp'; each becomes a presence request of kind leave, enter or swap. Updates can be postponed: PostponeCharacterInTriggerUpdates adds esv::camp::CharacterInTriggerChangedComponent to the character, CollectPostponedCharacterInTriggerUpdates removes it again and re-queues the update.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x9E31B0 (log string at line 249), +0x9E3670 lines 236-345, +0x9E2FB0 (AddComponent helper +0x9DD310 = frame storage of the global at EoCServer.dll+0x2230594 = CharacterInTriggerChangedComponent), +0x9E1DD0 line 171 (RemoveComponentUnchecked of the global at EoCServer.dll+0x2230594).
does.check: not checkable live: no recipe postpones an update (lead): {appears: esv::camp::CharacterInTriggerChangedComponent} then {gone} on the character would show the postpone path

does.text: Per request ('Processing TriggerChange'): a swap for a character not in camp is ignored; an enter for a character already in camp is treated as a swap; an enter or swap with an invalid trigger handle becomes a leave. Leave removes eoc::camp::PresenceComponent and esv::camp::TriggerComponent. Enter adds eoc::camp::PresenceComponent and esv::camp::TriggerComponent (the latter holding the trigger handle). Swap, only when the trigger stored in the character's TriggerComponent differs from the new one, writes the new trigger into it and adds esv::camp::TriggerChangedEventOneFrameComponent to the character ('Swapping the camp trigger from (%s) to (%s)'). Review 2026-11-14 (Opus, systems I): this is the same logic as the presence state machine the run branch described from bg3_dx11.exe+0x2BE33D0 (the kinds 0 leave, 1 enter, 2 swap are its states 0, 1, 2; the shape and the three adds match; matched by shape, not by a symbol). That description said a state-2 entity without PresenceComponent drops to 0 (a leave); it does not: in bg3_dx11.exe+0x2BE33D0 a swap without presence leaves the loop body untouched, and EoCServer.dll logs it as ignored. The removes are deferred: bg3_dx11.exe+0x400D0A0 appends a remove record (type index, storage index 0xFFFFFFFF) to the command buffer, the same record ECS.dll's EntityCommandBuffer::RemoveComponentUnchecked writes.
